rings.title: Adopt
rings.description: Our default. Use it on new projects unless there is a good reason not to.

rings.title: Trial
rings.description: Used on a real project and worth pursuing. Use where you can handle the risk.

rings.title: Assess
rings.description: Worth exploring to understand how it could affect us. Not for production yet.

rings.title: Hold
rings.description: Don't start anything new with it. Existing use is fine but plan to move away.
